positive_snippets: I didn't think there would be any other hotel like this in the Adarsh Nagar area. I really liked it there. The service, the people there, the environment there, everything was very good. The rooms are very beautiful. The rooms here are 3 star hotel quality.
negative_snippets: Dreadful place to stay. A colleague booked it for me. I checked in very late (gone 11.30pm) and handed over my passport. Then got a scored to room. Tried to get some sleep but was woken up at 12.30am by someone knocking on the door who I ignored. So they called on the room phone which I answered. Turns out they wanted a copy of my tourist visa (which is stamped in the passport). So I had to get dressed again to go to reception. It was such a noisy hotel (traffic and staff) especially in the morning. Good job I was up and out to airport very early.
